about.title: About Today’s Headlines
about.subtitle: Public news and technology updates from across the web.
about.coverageBody: We bring together more than 35 public platforms and official blogs across AI, technology, news, social, finance, and gaming, along with open-source and skill rankings. You can open the original sources, read AI summaries, or subscribe by RSS. Chinese translations are available in the Chinese interface.
about.step1Detail: Official RSS feeds and public rankings
about.step2Detail: Extract titles, links, and publication dates
about.step3Detail: Deduplicate stories and update the feed
about.step4Detail: Search and read on the site, or use RSS and MCP
about.copyrightBody: Titles, excerpts, and articles come from public pages. Copyright belongs to the original authors and platforms. We credit and link to the source. Updates are fetched at set intervals, so check the original for edits or removals.
about.faqFrequencyA: Major AI sources such as OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google AI, Zhipu GLM, and Qwen are checked every two hours. Technology, news, social, finance, gaming, and skill rankings sync every six hours.
about.faqRssQ: How do I subscribe via RSS?
about.faqRssA: Use the RSS menu at the top to copy the site-wide or channel RSS 2.0 URL, such as /feeds/ai.xml, into your reader. AI clients can connect through the <mcp>MCP service</mcp>.
about.privacyBody: You can browse without signing in. For data handling and external links, see the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy> and <terms>Terms of service</terms>.
about.contactBody: Maintained by <author>LJH</author>. Report broken links and layout issues, or suggest new sources, on <issues>GitHub Issues</issues>.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: How we handle data when you browse, search, or open external links.
privacy.noAccountBody: You can use the site without signing up or logging in. We do not collect your name, phone number, or email address. When Google AdSense or Google Analytics is enabled, its scripts use cookies to process device and visit information.
privacy.localStorageBody: Your theme, followed sources, reading list, and 100 most recent history entries stay in your browser’s local storage. They are not sent to the server. Clearing browser data resets the theme to dark.
privacy.siteSearchBody: Search terms and page numbers are sent to the server to match titles and excerpts. Search history is not tied to a personal account. Search terms appear in request logs, so avoid entering passwords or sensitive information.
privacy.accessLogsBody: Servers and network intermediaries receive the IP address, request path, and browser information needed for security and troubleshooting.
privacy.externalLinksBody: When you select Continue on the external link prompt, your browser opens the original third-party site, where that site’s privacy policy applies.
privacy.termsBody1: Titles, excerpts, and articles come from public pages and feeds. Copyright belongs to the original authors and platforms. We credit the sources and link to the originals.
privacy.termsBody2: Scheduled updates can lag behind the source. Machine translations and AI summaries are reading aids. Check the original for the facts.
privacy.termsBody3: RSS feeds (/feeds/*.xml), llms.txt, and MCP are for personal reading and ordinary tool use. Avoid frequent concurrent requests.
